# 1. The aborted gate at commit 1 — `21f11944402675e4d1aab3518d632e3329d2eef7`

The gate ran from clean commit 1. Numbered command 2 (`npm run typecheck`) exited 2 with three
errors. Per v15 §7.2 the run stopped, commit 1 stayed unamended, and a forward corrective commit
was authorised (v16). **Commands 6 to 9 and the build pair did NOT run in this attempt.** Commands
3, 4 and 5 had already been launched in the same batch as 2 and their output is recorded as it
occurred; they are not counted as a passing gate.

+      // `typeof retrieve` declares `opts` optional; retrieveMultiQuery always passes one. A real
+      // check, not a cast: if an arm ever arrived with no opts, that would be a finding.
+      assert.ok(o, 'retrieveMultiQuery passes an opts object to every arm');
+      arms.push({ query: q, useReranker: o.useReranker, rerankBackend: o.rerankBackend });
+      return retrieve(q, o, cap);
+    },
     rerankFn: async (q, c, third, deps, cap) => { fusion.push({ third, n: c.length }); return rerankMod.rerank(q, c, third, deps, cap); },
     // Deterministic variants, no LLM: the seam reports what it can (`not_collected`), honestly.
     variantsFn: async () => ['variant one of the question', 'variant two of the question'],
diff --git a/lib/__tests__/rerank-pass-2.test.ts b/lib/__tests__/rerank-pass-2.test.ts
index 593e941..4dd5caf 100644
--- a/lib/__tests__/rerank-pass-2.test.ts
+++ b/lib/__tests__/rerank-pass-2.test.ts
@@ -240,7 +240,11 @@ test('16.1 — Cohere selected, an UNTYPED throw: inputOrder returned, one synth
   assert.equal(capture.batches[0].outcome, 'terminal_failure');
   assert.equal(capture.batches[0].start, 0);
   assert.equal(capture.batches[0].end, 6);
-  assert.equal(capture.batches[0].evidence.provenNotServed, false, 'a generic throw carries no proof of non-delivery');
+  // `evidence` is nullable in the type; on this path recordSoftFailure always sets it. Assert the
+  // invariant, so a future regression fails as a test rather than as a type error.
+  const evidence = capture.batches[0].evidence;
+  assert.ok(evidence, 'a synthesised soft-failure batch carries an evidence record');
+  assert.equal(evidence.provenNotServed, false, 'a generic throw carries no proof of non-delivery');
   // Expected equals recorded, at the capture seam and in the manifest.
   assert.equal(capture.expectedBatchCount, 1);
   assert.equal(capture.rerankSoftFailed, true);

# 4. The first mutation table run, at `fe0eedb` — all twenty-two rows

Sandbox: a full copy of the worktree with `.next`, `node_modules` and `.git` removed and
`node_modules` symlinked, shape verified before use, deleted after. Rows 1–14 mutated
`lib/__tests__/judge-server-stub.ts`; rows 15–22 mutated `lib/rerank.ts`, `lib/retrieve.ts` and
`lib/multi-query.ts` in the sandbox copy only. Every mutated file was restored from the worktree's
committed bytes after its row and verified identical with `cmp`. No git command ran in the sandbox.

**Result: nineteen rows failed their named test. Three did not, and are recorded exactly.**

| Row | Change | Named test | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | limit 1048576 → 1048577 | 5.5b | ✘ 5.5b PASSED; 5.5a failed instead (its source pin, not the boundary) |
| 2 | limit 1048576 → 1048575 | 5.5a | ✔ |
| 3 | snapshot returns the internal array | 5.7 | ✔ |
| 4 | snapshot returns the same Buffer | 5.7 | ✔ |
| 5 | seq assigned at response end | 5.4 | ✔ |
| 6 | snapshot: refusal removed | 5.6 | ✘ file TIMED OUT at 60 s; 5.6 never reported by name |
| 7 | resetObservations: refusal removed | 5.6 | ✘ file TIMED OUT at 60 s; 5.6 never reported by name |
| 8 | reset also clears scores | 5.10 | ✔ |
| 9 | deduplicate identical | 5.8 | ✔ |
| 10 | 200 instead of 413 | 5.5b | ✔ |
| 11 | record while off | 5.2 | ✔ |
| 12 | header value on observation | 5.3 | ✔ |
| 13 | compare by arrival order | 5.9 | ✔ |
| 14 | recorder field on JudgeRequest | 5.11 | ✔ |
| 15 | hoist checkHealthy | J2 | ✔ J2.1 |
| 16 | explicit judge calls cohereFn | J2 | ✔ J2.1 |
| 17 | judge before checkHealthy | 70.1 | ✔ |
| 18 | expected from intendedBackend | 18.3 | ✔ |
| 19 | remove per-batch try/catch | 17.1 | ✔ |
| 20 | retrieve passes undefined backend | J3.2 | ✔ |
| 21 | arms useReranker: true | J4.1 | ✔ |
| 22 | second fusion rerank | J4.1 | ✔ |

Row 1's cause: 5.5b built its body as `Buffer.alloc(RECORDER_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES + 1)`, so the mutated
constant moved the body to 1048578, which the mutated limit still rejected. Rows 6/7's cause: 5.6
released its held request only after the assertions, so a failing `assert.throws` left the request
open and `recorded()`'s `finally` waited on `settled()` forever. Both are defects in the tests, not
in the recorder, and both were repaired in the second corrective commit (section 5).

# 5. The second corrective commit — `9344cdbda014acabcae2d0c09c718fdda12e4b87`

One path, per addendum v17 §3. Literal boundaries in 5.5a, 5.5b and 5.6b; `release()` in a
`finally` in 5.6 and — found by the §3.2 sweep — in 5.4. The other three pass 2 files open no raw
`http.request` and were untouched.
